title: hybrid.rs: Evidence expiration comment describes unimplemented wraparound check
description: Lines 316-319: Comment says 'Handle wraparound: if age is greater than half the u32 range, it's likely a future timestamp' but no such check exists. After wrap, evidence from 0xFFFFFF00 with now=0x00000100 yields age=512ms, incorrectly appearing fresh when actually ~50 days old.
